The sender encrypts and publishes a JSON message; the receiver subscribes to the same topic, decrypts it and displays it. The broker handles ciphertext only. Its address is stored in an external configuration file.

Cryptographie appliquée (AES, PBKDF2, SH: Applied cryptography (AES, PBKDF2 and SHA-256), MQTT, structured Java development and Linux administration on a local network.
